metadata.case_name: MUHAMMAD ASGHAR v. TAK SHING METAL CO

injuries.description: X-ray showed spondylolisthesis of L5/S1 but no other bony lesion was found.
source: X-ray showed spondylolisthesis of L5/S1 but no other bony lesion was found.

injuries.description: A CT myelogram ... revealed Grade 1 retrolisthesis at L4/5 level
source: A CT myelogram was performed on 9 August which revealed Grade 1 retrolisthesis at L4/5 level and spondylosis at L5 but with no significant disc prolapse.
A CT myelogram was performed on 9 August which revealed Grade 1 retrolisthesis at L4/5 level and spondylosis at L5 but with no significant disc prolapse.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: An MRI ... revealed slight posterior displacement of L4 onto L5 with mild to moderate protrusion of the disc but without compressing the anterior thecal sac.
source: An MRI was performed on 21 May 2003 which revealed slight posterior displacement of L4 onto L5 with mild to moderate protrusion of the disc but without compressing the anterior thecal sac.

injuries.description: At the UCH, the plaintiff was diagnosed to have tenderness of lower lumbar spine.
source: At the UCH, the plaintiff was diagnosed to have tenderness of lower lumbar spine.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

source: the plaintiff suffers from a Conversion Disorder
the plaintiff was genuinely suffering from Conversion Disorder and was not malingering.
referred to South Kwai Chung Psychiatric Centre on 1 April 2004 and diagnosed to be suffering from mild to moderate depressive episode.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury (opinion of Dr Woo)
source: Dr Woo on the other hand opined that the plaintiff suffered a soft tissue injury

manifestations.description: numbness of the left lower leg
bizarre gait with left leg stretched out and spine tilted to one side
total loss of motor control in left leg

treatments_received: Ambulance transport to United Christian Hospital Emergency Department
Admission to United Christian Hospital (19 July 2002 to 25 July 2002)
Re-admission to United Christian Hospital (7 August 2002 to 13 August 2002)
Outpatient physiotherapy at United Christian Hospital and Princess Margaret Hospital
Manipulation under anaesthetic was offered but the patient later refused
Psychiatric assessment and treatment at South Kwai Chung Psychiatric Centre and PMH outpatient clinic
Hypnotherapy with Mr Kelvin Tang (about 9 sessions between January and November 2007 and a further three consultations in 2008)
treatments_future: Further six sessions of hypnotherapy with Mr Kelvin Tang (recommended)

losses.description: Lengthy discomfort of the bizarre gait and posture and low back pain since the time of the accident.
Psychological distress and depressive disorder attendant with his incapacity.
Reduced ability to return to pre-accident heavy manual work and loss of earnings capacity.
